subject: Theorem 1.1
object: for a generic metric on a compact spin three-manifold the Dirac operator has only simple eigenvalues

subject: Theorem 1.2
object: for a compact spin three-manifold M the set S(M) of metrics with all eigenvalues simple is residual

subject: Remark 1.3(1)
object: in each conformal class the set of metrics for which all non-zero eigenvalues are simple is residual

subject: Remark 1.3(2)
object: in any dimension the set of metrics with dim E_lambda at most rank of the spinor bundle for all non-zero lambda is residual

subject: Remark 2.2
object: Theorem 2.1

subject: Theorem 2.1
object: for an eigenvalue of D with multiplicity p there are real analytic eigenvalue curves and orthonormal smooth eigenspinor curves for small t

subject: Lemma 3.1
object: for a non-zero eigenvalue with quaternionic dimension p greater than 1 there is a conformal deformation of g splitting E_lambda into lower-dimensional eigenspaces

subject: Proposition 3.2
object: the sets S^k(M), k at least 1, are open and dense in R(M)

subject: gamma_tf
object: the frame map sending each frame e_i to e^{-tf} e_i

subject: D^t
object: e^{-tf}(D phi + ((n-1)/2) t grad f . phi), the Dirac operator of the conformal metric g^t

subject: (phi, psi)_{g^t}
object: the L2 inner product with respect to g^t, equal to the integral of <phi,psi> e^{ntf} dmu

subject: lambda^t
object: Re integral of <D phi^t, phi^t> e^{(n-1)tf} dmu

subject: lambda'
object: lambda times the integral of 2 Re<phi', phi> + (n-1) f |phi|^2 dmu

subject: Eq. (8) integral condition
object: integral of 2 Re<phi', phi> + n f |phi|^2 dmu equals zero

subject: lambda'
object: minus lambda times the integral of f |phi|^2 dmu

subject: alpha_{p,q}^t and beta_{p,q}^t
object: D alpha_{p,q}^t = lambda^t alpha_{p,q}^t and D beta_{p,q}^t = lambda^t beta_{p,q}^t

subject: alpha_{p,q}^0 and beta_{p,q}^0
object: the integral of f |alpha_{p,q}^0|^2 dmu equals lambda' equals the integral of f |beta_{p,q}^0|^2 dmu

subject: Eq. (13) expansion identity
object: the expression with minus 2 Re<phi_1^0, i^p J^q phi_2^0> equals the expression with plus 2 Re<phi_1^0, i^p J^q phi_2^0>

subject: spectrum ordering
object: eigenvalues ordered as ... <= lambda_{-1} < 0 < lambda_1 <= lambda_2 <= ...

subject: positive spectrum with multiplicity
object: 0 < lambda_1 < ... < lambda_{k-1} < lambda_k = ... = lambda_{k+p-1} < lambda_{k+p} <= ...

subject: spectrum of the Dirac operator on spherical space forms, flat manifolds and spheres with Berger metrics
object: explicitly computed

subject: J
object: R-linear endomorphism of the spinor space with J^2 = -1 and Ji = -iJ commuting with Spin(n), existing when n is 3, 4, or 5 mod 8

subject: S(M)
object: the subset of metrics on M for which all eigenvalues of the Dirac operator are simple

subject: simple eigenvalue
object: an eigenvalue lambda with dim_H E_lambda = 1

subject: residual
object: a subset containing a countable intersection of open and dense sets
